desc: Configuration Parameters for the Can Nm module. Post-Build Variant Support true Supported Config Variants VARIANT-LINK-TIME, VARIANT-POST-BUILD, VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

This container contains the global configuration parameter of the CanNm. The parameters and the parameters of the sub containers shall be mapped to the C data type CanNm_ConfigType (for parameters where it is possible) which is passed to the CanNm_Init function. Configuration Parameters

name: CanNmBusLoadReductionEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling busload reduction support.

name: CanNmBusSynchronizationEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling bus synchronization support. This feature is required for gateway nodes only.

name: CanNmComControlEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling the Communication Control support.

name: CanNmComUserDataSupport
desc: Preprocessor switch for enabling the Tx path of Com User Data. Use case: Setting of NMUserData via SWC.

name: CanNmCoordinatorSyncSupport
desc: Enables/disables the coordinator synchronization support.

name: CanNmDevErrorDetect
desc: Switches the development error detection and notification on or off.  true: detection and notification is enabled.

name: CanNmDynamicPncToChannelMappingSupport
desc: Precompile time switch to enable the dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping handling. False: Dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping is disabled True: Dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping is enabled Tags: atp.Status=draft

name: CanNmGlobalPnSupport
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling partial networking support globally.

name: CanNmImmediateRestartEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling the immediate transmission of a NM PDU upon bus-communication request in Prepare-Bus-Sleep mode.

name: CanNmImmediateTxconfEnabled
desc: Enable/disable the immediate tx confirmation.

name: CanNmMainFunctionPeriod
desc: Call cycle in seconds of CanNm_MainFunction.

name: CanNmPassiveModeEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling support of the Passive Mode.

name: CanNmPduRxIndicationEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling the PDU Rx Indication.

name: CanNmPnEiraCalcEnabled
desc: Specifies if CanNm calculates the PN request information for internal an external requests. (EIRA) true: PN request are calculated false: PN request are not calculated Tags: atp.Status=obsolete

name: CanNmPnResetTime
desc: Specifies the runtime of the reset timer in seconds. This reset time is valid for the reset of PN requests in the EIRA and in the ERA. The value shall be the same for every channel. Thus it is a global config parameter. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete

name: CanNmPnSyncShutdownErrorReactionEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling reaction, if a top-level PNC coordinator received a PN shutdown message on a NM-channel which refer to a ComM channel that is actively coordinated by a PNC gateway. Tags: atp.Status=draft

name: CanNmRemoteSleepIndEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling remote sleep indication support. This feature is required for gateway nodes only.

name: CanNmStateChangeIndEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling the CAN NM state change notification.

name: CanNmUserDataEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling user data support.

name: CanNmVersionInfoApi
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling version info API support.

name: CanNmPnEiraRxNSduRef
desc: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack. Only one SduRef is required for CanNm because the EIRA is the aggregation over all Can Channels. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete
This container contains the channel specific configuration parameter of the CanNm. Post-Build Variant

name: CanNmActiveWakeupBitEnabled
desc: Enables/Disables the handling of the Active Wakeup Bit in the CanNm module.

name: CanNmAllNmMessagesKeepAwake
desc: Specifies if CanNm drops irrelevant NM PDUs. false: Only NM PDUs with a PNI bit = true and containing a PN request for this ECU triggers the standard RX indication handling true: Every NM PDU triggers the standard RX indication handling

name: CanNmBusLoadReductionActive
desc: This parameter defines if bus load reduction for the respective NM channel is active or not.

name: CanNmCarWakeUpBitPosition
desc: Specifies the Bit position of the CWU within the NM PDU.

name: CanNmCarWakeUpBytePosition
desc: Specifies the Byte position of the CWU within the NM PDU.

name: CanNmCarWakeUpFilterEnabled
desc: If CWU filtering is supported, only the CWU bit within the NM PDU with source node identifier CanNmCarWakeUpFilterNodeId is considered as CWU request. FALSE - CWU filtering is not supported TRUE - CWU filtering is supported

name: CanNmCarWakeUpFilterNodeId
desc: Source node identifier for CWU filtering. If CWU filtering is supported, only the CWU bit within the NM PDU with source node identifier CanNmCarWakeUpFilterNodeId is considered as CWU request.

name: CanNmCarWakeUpRxEnabled
desc: Enables or disables support of CarWakeUp bit evaluation in received NM PDUs. FALSE - CarWakeUp not supported TRUE - CarWakeUp supported

name: CanNmDynamicPncToChannelMappingEnabled
desc: Channel-specific parameter to enable the dynamic PNC-to-channel- mapping feature. False: Dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping is disabled True: Dynamic PNC-to-channel-mapping is enabled Tags: atp.Status=draft

name: CanNmImmediateNmCycleTime
desc: Defines the immediate NM PDU cycle time in seconds which is used for CanNmImmediateNmTransmissions NM PDU transmissions.

name: CanNmImmediateNmTransmissions
desc: Defines the number of immediate NM PDUs which shall be transmitted. If the value is zero no immediate NM PDUs are transmitted. The cycle time of immeditate NM PDUs is defined by CanNmImmediateNmCycleTime.

name: CanNmMsgCycleOffset
desc: Time offset in the periodic transmission node. It determines the start delay of the transmission. Specified in seconds.

name: CanNmMsgCycleTime
desc: Period of a NM PDU in seconds. It determines the periodic rate in the "periodic transmission mode with bus load reduction" and is the basis for transmit scheduling in the "periodic transmission mode without bus load reduction".

name: CanNmMsgReducedTime
desc: Node specific bus cycle time in the periodic transmission mode with bus load reduction. Specified in seconds.

name: CanNmMsgTimeoutTime
desc: When using Partial Network and this timeout is defined then CanNm monitors that a NM-PDU is transmitted successfully within this Transmission Timeout Time and provides an error notification otherwise.

name: CanNmNodeDetectionEnabled
desc: Precompile time switch to enable the node detection feature.

name: CanNmNodeId
desc: Node identifier of local node.

name: CanNmNodeIdEnabled
desc: Pre-processor switch for enabling the source node identifier.

name: CanNmPduCbvPosition
desc: Defines the position of the control bit vector within the NM PDU. The value of the parameter represents the location of the Control Bit Vector in the NM PDU (CanNmPduByte0 means byte 0, CanNmPduByte1 means byte 1, CanNmPduOff means source node identifier is not part of the NM PDU)

name: CanNmPnEnabled
desc: Enables or disables support of partial networking. false: Partial networking Range not supported true: Partial networking supported

name: CanNmPnEraCalcEnabled
desc: Specifies if CanNm calculates the PN request information for external requests. (ERA) false: PN request are not calculated true: PN request are calculated Tags: atp.Status=obsolete

name: CanNmPnHandleMultipleNetworkRequests
desc: Specifies if CanNm performs an additional transition from Network Mode to Repeat Message State (true) or not (false).

name: CanNmRemoteSleepIndTime
desc: Timeout for Remote Sleep Indication. It defines the time in seconds how long it shall take to recognize that all other nodes are ready to sleep.

name: CanNmRepeatMessageTime
desc: Timeout for Repeat Message State. It defines the time in seconds how long the NM shall stay in the Repeat Message State.

name: CanNmRepeatMsgIndEnabled
desc: Enable/disable the notification that a RepeatMessageRequest bit has been received.

name: CanNmStayInPbsEnabled
desc: If this parameter is disabled Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode is left after CanNmWaitBusSleepTime. If this parameter is enabled Prepare Bus- Sleep Mode can only be left if ECU is powered off or any restart reason applies.

name: CanNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled
desc: Specifies if CanNm handle PN shutdown messages to support a synchronized PNC shutdown across a PN topology. This is only used for

name: CanNmTimeoutTime
desc: Network Timeout for NM PDUs. It denotes the time in seconds how long the NM shall stay in the Ready Sleep State before transition into the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode is initiated.

name: CanNmWaitBusSleepTime
desc: Timeout for bus calm down phase. It denotes the time in seconds how long the NM shall stay in the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode before transition into Bus-Sleep Mode shall take place.

name: CanNmComMNetworkHandleRef
desc: This reference points to the unique channel defined by the ComMChannel and provides access to the unique channel index value in ComMChannelId.

name: CanNmPnEraRxNSduRef
desc: Reference to a Pdu in the COM-Stack. The SduRef is required for every CanNm Channel, because ERA is reported per channel. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete
This container is used to configure the Rx PDU properties that are used for the CanNm Channel. Configuration Parameters

name: CanNmRxPduId
desc: This parameter defines the Rx PDU ID of the CanIf L-PDU range that is associated with this CanNm channel.

name: CanNmRxPduRef
desc: Reference to the global PDU that is used by this CanNm channel.
This container contains the CanNmTxConfirmationPduId and the CanNmTxPduRef. Configuration Parameters

name: CanNmTxConfirmationPduId
desc: Handle Id to be used by the Lower Layer to confirm the transmission of the CanNmTxPdu to the LowerLayer.

name: CanNmTxPduRef
desc: The reference to the common PDU structure.
This optional container is used to configure the UserNm PDU. This container is only available if CanNmComUserDataSupport is enabled. Configuration Parameters

name: CanNmTxUserDataPduId
desc: This parameter defines the Handle ID of the NM User Data I-PDU.

name: CanNmTxUserDataPduRef
desc: Reference to the NM User Data I-PDU in the global PDU collection.
PN information configuration Tags: atp.Status=obsolete Configuration Parameters

name: CanNmPnInfoLength
desc: Specifies the length of the PN request information in the NM PDU. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete

name: CanNmPnInfoOffset
desc: Specifies the offset of the PN request information in the NM PDU. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete
PN information configuration Tags: atp.Status=obsolete Configuration Parameters

name: CanNmPnFilterMaskByteIndex
desc: Index of the filter mask byte. Specifies the position within the filter mask byte array. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete

name: CanNmPnFilterMaskByteValue
desc: Parameter to configure the filter mask byte. Tags: atp.Status=obsolete
